thread:
tanya: quick postmortem-ish thread. observed billing mismatches after yesterday's rolloutlow traffic but a handful of tenants showed duplicated token charges. collecting notes and options.

ben: can you summarize the pipeline gap?

tanya: short: router buckets by a short window and the compact/dedupe step only sees the bucket key. when retries cross bucket boundaries (or land in another region) we treat them as distinct and later compaction merges incorrectly causing double-charge corrections.

omar: are these client-side retries or server recoveries?

tanya: both. some clients retried, and in ~3 cases autoscaler evicted workers which re-enqueued cached requests.

ria: paste current router config?

tanya: config excerpt:
```
router:
  ttl_ms: 180000   # 3m
  fanout_ms: 450000 # 7.5m
  dedupe_bucket: [ token_hash, floor(arrival_ts / ttl_ms) ]
```

kevin: token_hash is client-supplied for some SDKs and not guaranteed stable. that's a footgun.

ben: so we have three levers: (A) increase ttl to cover retry tail, (B) compute a server-side idempotency key (normalizing payload + tenant) and use that for dedupe, (C) keep short ttl but emit provisional billing rows and later reconcile to canonical events.

omar: tradeoffs: (A) eases merging but increases cache residency; (B) is robust but needs payload normalization docs + KMS if we sign keys; (C) keeps router cheap but doubles interim storage and needs a reconciler job.

ria: cross-region note: if a retry lands in a different region and we rely on in-memory router buckets, it's lost. idemp sig or a shared fast-store is required for cross-region dedupe.

ops-bot: infra note: global memcache replication across regions has ~200ms lag and is not strictly consistent.

kevin: propose staged plan: 1) emergency: raise ttl to 10m for canaries to reduce current noise, 2) prototype "provisional" tag path that emits provisional_event rows to billing-store with source=router and provisional_id, 3) build reconciler to match provisionals to canonical finalizer events, 4) long-term: idemp-key with payload canonicalization + optional KMS signing.

ben: prefer provisional prototype first because it's non-invasive to dedupe logic and gives audit trail. we can iterate reconciler behavior without changing router dedupe semantics.

tanya: prototype design sketch:
1) router emits provisional row: {provisional_id, token_id, arrival_ts, src_region}
2) finalizer emits canonical row: {canonical_id, token_id, provisional_id? (if seen), final_attrib}
3) reconciler scans ordering-keyed store and 1:1 matches by token_id + provisional_id or token_id + idemp_key as fallback
4) reconciler writes adjustment rows and marks provisionals resolved; if unmatched after retention window mark orphaned and escalate billing ops.

omar: how do we limit storage bloat? storing full provisionals for 30d will double our billing-store if not pruned. sampling + lightweight tombstone approach suggested: keep full payload only for tenants above threshold, else keep index pointer to raw router logs.

kevin: also add metrics: provisional_emitted, provisional_resolved, orphan_rate, reconcile_failures, avg_resolve_latency. set alert if orphan_rate > 0.2% for 30m.

ria: runbook: billing-ops gets a dashboard and a quick workflow to pause provisional billing for a tenant if noise is high. Ops will use reconcile dry-run output to approve credit adjustments.

ben: short-term owner assignments: tanya -> ttl bump + canary monitor; kevin -> reconcile metrics + helm change to emit provisional tag boolean; omar -> reconciler skeleton job.

ops-bot: deploy: canary on region-us-east-1 scheduled at 7350001205 for router-config by tanya.

kevin: one gotcha: payloads can differ on retry (client adds debug field). idemp key requires canonicalizer that strips non-semantic fields. add canonicalization rules to backlog.

ria: capture decisions: TEMP ttl bump to 10m, PROTOTYPE provisional pathway on 1 shard, DO NOT change dedupe_key until reconciler behavior validated, LONGTERM idemp key + canonicalization + KMS signing.

tanya: filing follow-ups: PR for ttl bump, ticket for provisional prototype (+ schema), runbook for billing-ops, RFC for idemp canonicalization. I'll link here once created. thanks all.

ben: thanks. small side note 50 tenants affected but top 10 accounted for >80% of noise, so sampling idea helps costs.

omar: will start reconciler skeleton in next sprint and post design doc. reopening thread when we have metrics.

ops-bot: note: router-canary rollback window 30m.

kevin: adding that we should consider opt-in per-tenant provisional for enterprise customers to avoid surprises.

ria: good idea. we'll surface as billing toggle in console later.

ben: closing this thread, will follow up in eng-platform weekly with progress.
